cells.quote: "A moderate positive correlation was found between the % of maximum possible QATSDD score and the year of publication (R = 0.534, P < 0.001). The mean global % of maximum possible QATSDD score was 52.6% (SD 20.5%; Minimum 7.14%, Maximum 95.2%)."

O.outcome_detail: incorporation of EPAs into nutrition and dietetics assessment

cells.quote: The involvement of key stakeholders, including content experts relevant to the purpose of the papers and academic staff, in EPA development was evident across all included studies.
cells.note: The review reports stakeholder involvement as a recurring factor but does not provide a direct comparison or quantify its effect on incorporation.
